description: Given a paper_id, return the most semantically similar papers by embedding distance, NOT by citation links. Use for “more papers like this one” / “adjacent work on the same topic”. For papers this one cites or that cite it, use `get_paper_citations` instead. Each hit carries metadata, abstract, the closest non-abstract matched chunk as `contexts`, and a `similarity` score (0..1, higher is nearer). Returns up to `limit` papers; an unknown paper_id is an error, an empty list means no neighbors were found.

paper_id.description: A corpus paper UUID (from a paper search) to find neighbors for.

name: search_related_papers

papers.description: Semantically nearest papers by embedding distance (NOT citation links), ordered nearest-first; empty when none were found.

contexts.description: Nearest non-abstract matched chunk(s) from this related paper, currently at most one. Empty when no parsed chunk is available.

chunk_id.description: Stable id of the source chunk; deep-links the exact matched span.

score.description: Retriever relevance score for the chunk.

section.description: Section the chunk came from (e.g. Methods, Results).

text.description: The exact matched text span from the paper.

paper_id.description: Lune paper UUID. A fetch handle for get_paper_fulltext; do not show it to the user. Cite by title, authors, and venue.

similarity.description: Embedding cosine similarity to the seed paper (higher is nearer, ~1 is almost identical). Use it to gauge how related each neighbour is.

title: Search related papers
